BL-2105 — A scoped Stryker dry run is budgeted for the suite it runs: extension/stryker.config.json sets no dryRunTimeoutMinutes, so every scoped run copied from it starts at Stryker's 5-minute default while the perTest dry run executes the whole unit suite (about 10 minutes on this host) - twice the dry run hit that ceiling and the hardener fell back to hand mutation; the base config carries the 15-minute budget six per-ticket configs already set by hand
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. FIRM: only the dry-run budget changes; timeoutMS, timeoutFactor, concurrency and coverageAnalysis stay as they are. FIRM: the per-ticket configs are not edited.
BL-2105 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-2105" (or "reject BL-2105 <reason>") to act.
